threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still refer to Ridley Road Market as the 'Dalston Market' instead of its proper name. That’s a sure sign you’re fresh off the boat.
Heard a couple arguing over whether Jerk chicken or Fried chicken was the best midnight snack. Classic Brixton vibes, though you know the jerk wins every time.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw a group of kids using an abandoned lot to host a mini talent show, complete with an audience of cats lounging nearby.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can find spontaneous techno parties in abandoned buildings here, but good luck getting a currywurst after midnight. It’s a wild mix!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local when they know to avoid BART during rush hour because of random delays. Tourists are still shocked by the train chaos on Fridays.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Watched a guy in a suit try to squeeze his briefcase in the bike rack on a crowded 38. He was so determined, you'd think it was his last chance.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can hop on the metro any time; the locals know it’s a game of chance after 10 PM—good luck finding a bus!

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You'll catch them staring at the metro map like it's a treasure map, trying to decipher 5 different lines at once.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still ask for directions to the nearest tube station without knowing it’s just a five-minute walk. That’s a dead giveaway.
Caught a night bus to Brixton and the driver was singing along to 90s R&B like it was a karaoke night. Most passengers grinned like it was the best gig in town.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Walking past the kids playing football in the park while the kebab shop down the street is blasting old Turkish pop—only in Neukölln, you know.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you find a club with a swimming pool right in the dance floor. Spreepark's techno parties are a wild dive into nightlife!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Locals know to carry an extra sweater even in July—those fog banks roll in faster than a tech bro's coffee order.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo pull out a ukulele on the 19 bus, serenading a confused crowd. Only in San Francisco.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often miss how late the locals eat dinner. While they grub at 7, we’re just starting to think about it around 9 or 10!

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their confusion over the 'tapas' hours; asking for dinner at 6 PM raises some eyebrows in the bars around Plaça del Sol.
